arxiv-2007-05265.title: Decentralized Accessibility of e -commerce Products through Blockchain Technology
arxiv-2007-05265.creator: Gulshan Kumar, Rahul Saha, William J Buchanan, G. Geetha, Reji Thomas, Tai-Hoon Kim, Mamoun Alazab
arxiv-2007-05265.description: Abstract A distributed and transparent ledger system is considered for various e -commerce products including health medicines, electronics, security appliances, food products and many more to ensure technological and e-commerce sustainability. This solution, named as ’PRODCHAIN’, is a generic blockchain framework with lattice-based cryptographic processes for reducing the complexity for tracing the e-commerce products.

arxiv-2104-12674.title: The Relative Consistency of the Axiom of Choice Mechanized Using Isabelle/ZF
arxiv-2104-12674.creator: Lawrence C. Paulson
arxiv-2104-12674.description: Abstract The proof of the relative consistency of the axiom of choice has been mechanized using Isabelle/ZF. The proof builds upon a previous mechanization of the reflection theorem [ 18 ] . The heavy reliance on metatheory in the original proof makes the formalization unusually long, and not entirely satisfactory: two parts of the proof do not fit together.

arxiv-2107-06786.title: Bose-Hubbard realization of fracton defects
arxiv-2107-06786.creator: Krzysztof Giergiel, Ruben Lier, Piotr Surówka, Arkadiusz Kosior
arxiv-2107-06786.description: Abstract Bose-Hubbard models are simple paradigmatic lattice models used to study dynamics and phases of quantum bosonic matter. We combine the extended Bose-Hubbard model in the hard-core regime with ring-exchange hoppings. By investigating the symmetries and low-energy properties of the Hamiltonian we argue that the model hosts fractonic defect excitations.

arxiv-2203-09946.title: Prompt-based Generative Approach towards Multi-Hierarchical Medical Dialogue State Tracking
arxiv-2203-09946.creator: Jun Liu, Tong Ruan, Haofen Wang, Huanhuan Zhang
arxiv-2203-09946.description: Abstract The medical dialogue system is a promising application that can provide great convenience for patients. The dialogue state tracking (DST) module in the medical dialogue system which interprets utterances into the machine-readable structure for downstream tasks is particularly challenging.

arxiv-2206-05060.title: Social Network Structure Shapes Innovation: Experience sharing in RL with sapiens
arxiv-2206-05060.creator: Eleni Nisioti, Mateo Mahaut, Pierre-Yves Oudeyer, Ida Momennejad, Clément Moulin-Frier
arxiv-2206-05060.description: Abstract Human culture relies on innovation: our ability to continuously explore how existing elements can be combined to create new ones. Innovation is not solitary, it relies on collective search and accumulation. Reinforcement learning (RL) approaches commonly assume that fully-connected groups are best suited for innovation.

arxiv-2208-13025.title: A stochastic model for the residence time of solid particles in turbulent Rayleigh-Bénard Flow
arxiv-2208-13025.creator: Colin J. Denzel, Andrew D. Bragg, David H. Richter
arxiv-2208-13025.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Colin J. Denzel, Andrew D. Bragg, David H. Richter. The Pi Chamber, located at Michigan Technological University, generates moist turbulent Rayleigh-Bénard flow in order to replicate steady-state cloud conditions. We take inspiration from this setup and consider a particle-laden, convectively-driven turbulent flow using direct numerical simulation (DNS).

arxiv-2302-09281.title: A NEW SCIENTIFIC INDEXING MODEL: U-INDEX
arxiv-2302-09281.creator: Ugur Saglam, Fatih Canata
arxiv-2302-09281.description: Abstract H-index has become more popular nowadays and is used for some scientific performance criteria in the world widely. This indexing method does not correctly measure any performance or carrier specifications because of the parameters that are used to form the measurement basis.

arxiv-2305-04627.title: Bounds for the random walk speed in terms of the Teichmüller distance
arxiv-2305-04627.creator: Aitor Azemar
arxiv-2305-04627.description: Abstract Consider a closed surface S S with negative Euler characteristic, and an admissible probability measure on the fundamental group of S S with finite first moment with respect to some hyperbolic metric on S S . Corresponding to each point in Teichmüller space there is an associated random walk on the hyperbolic plane.

arxiv-2309-11328.title: Transport-based fusion that distinguishes between Majorana and Andreev bound states
arxiv-2309-11328.creator: Maximilian Nitsch, Rubén Seoane Souto, Stephanie Matern, Martin Leijnse
arxiv-2309-11328.description: Abstract It has proven difficult to distinguish between topological Majorana bound states and nontopological Andreev bound states and to measure the unique properties of the former. In this work, we aim to alleviate this problem by proposing and theoretically analyzing a new type of fusion protocol based on transport measurements in a Majorana box coupled to normal leads.

arxiv-2406-13964.title: Hierarchical Micro-Segmentations for Zero-Trust Services via Large Language Model (LLM)-enhanced Graph Diffusion Thanks: Y. Liu, G. Liu, H. Du, and D. Niyato are with the College of Computing and Data Science, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (e-mail: yinqiu001@e.ntu.edu.sg, liug0022@e.nt
arxiv-2406-13964.creator: Yinqiu Liu *, Guangyuan Liu *, Hongyang Du, Dusit Niyato, Fellow, IEEE, Jiawen Kang
arxiv-2406-13964.description: Abstract In the rapidly evolving Next-Generation Networking (NGN) era, the adoption of zero-trust architectures has become increasingly crucial to protect security. However, provisioning zero-trust services in NGNs poses significant challenges, primarily due to the environmental complexity and dynamics. Motivated by these challenges, this paper explores efficient zero-trust service provisioning using hierarchical micro-segmentations.

arxiv-2407-03098.title: Magnetization nutation in magnetic semiconductors: Effective spin model with anisotropic RKKY exchange interaction
arxiv-2407-03098.creator: H. Kachkachi
arxiv-2407-03098.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by H. Kachkachi. We demonstrate that the magnetization in magnetic semiconductors exhibits nutational motion when subjected to an external magnetic field. This behavior originates from the splitting of the conduction-electron band which induces anisotropic, distance-dependent exchange coupling between localized spins. To investigate this phenomenon, we examine a general system that includes both charge and spin degrees of freedom, characteristic of a magnetic semiconductor.

arxiv-2407-18955.title: Real Face Video Animation Platform DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX 123-A56-BU3 CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial intelligence CCS: Human-centered computing Visualization
arxiv-2407-18955.creator: Xiaokai Chen, Xuan Liu, Donglin Di, Yongjia Ma, Wei Chen, Tonghua Su
arxiv-2407-18955.description: Abstract . In recent years, facial video generation models have gained popularity. However, these models often lack expressive power when dealing with exaggerated anime-style faces due to the absence of high-quality anime-style face training sets. We propose a facial animation platform that enables real-time conversion from real human faces to cartoon-style faces, supporting multiple models.

arxiv-2409-02983.title: Precise and Accurate Mass and Radius Measurements of Fifteen Galactic Red Giants in Detached Eclipsing Binaries
arxiv-2409-02983.creator: D. M. Rowan 1,2, K. Z. Stanek 1,2, C. S. Kochanek 1,2, Todd A. Thompson 1,2,3, T. Jayasinghe 4 J. Blaum 5, B. J. Fulton 6, I. Ilyin 7, H. Isaacson 5, N. LeBaron 5, Jessica R. Lu 5, David V. Martin 8
arxiv-2409-02983.description: Abstract Precise and accurate mass and radius measurements of evolved stars are crucial to calibrating stellar models. Stars in detached eclipsing binaries (EBs) are excellent potential calibrators because their stellar parameters can be measured with fractional uncertainties of a few percent, independent of stellar models.

arxiv-2410-08385.title: Language model developers should report train-test overlap
arxiv-2410-08385.creator: Andy K Zhang, Kevin Klyman, Yifan Mai, Yoav Levine, Yian Zhang, Rishi Bommasani, Percy Liang
arxiv-2410-08385.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Andy K Zhang, Kevin Klyman, Yifan Mai, Yoav Levine, Yian Zhang, Rishi Bommasani, Percy Liang. Language models are extensively evaluated, but correctly interpreting evaluation results requires knowledge of train-test overlap , which refers to the extent to which the language model is trained on the very data it is being tested on.

arxiv-2411-18486.title: A new potential method for the X max X_{\mathrm{max}} measurement of extensive air showers based on backtracking radio signals
arxiv-2411-18486.creator: V.B. Jhansi, S. Thoudam, S. Buitink, A. Corstanje, M. Desmet, J. R. Hörandel, T. Huege, K. Mulrey, O. Scholten
arxiv-2411-18486.description: Abstract Measurements of cosmic-ray composition based on air-shower measurements rely mostly on the determination of the position of the shower maximum ( X max X_{\mathrm{max}} ). One efficient technique is to image the development of the air shower using fluorescence telescopes.

arxiv-2511-07591.title: Nonclassical State Generation and Quantum Metrology in the Double-Morse Potential
arxiv-2511-07591.creator: Firoz Chogle ,, Berihu Teklu, Jorge Zubelli, Ernesto Damiani ,
arxiv-2511-07591.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the nonlinear properties of the double-Morse potential as a possible resource for single-mode quantum states because of its double-well structure and anharmonicity. We derive the ground state wave function and the associated energy spectrum analytically, using the asymmetry (width parameter) α \alpha as the primary control parameter.

arxiv-2511-13451.title: Probing parameters estimation with Gaussian non-commutative measurements
arxiv-2511-13451.creator: Alice P. G. Hall, Carlos H. S. Vieira, Jonas F. G. Santos
arxiv-2511-13451.description: Abstract Gaussian quantum states and channels are pivotal across many branches of quantum science and their applications, including the processing and storage of quantum information, the investigation of thermodynamics in the quantum regime, and quantum computation. The great advantage is that Gaussian states are experimentally accessible via their first and second statistical moments.

pmc-12416660.title: Risk factors for Overweight/Obesity among people living with HIV on antiretroviral therapy: An ambidirectional cohort study at a tertiary health facility in Zambia
pmc-12416660.creator: Benson M. Hamooya, Lukundo Siame, Matenge Mutalange, Chilala Cheelo, Kingsley Kamvuma, Sepiso K. Masenga, Chanda Chitalu, Sadeep Shrestha, Samuel Bosomprah, Anne Kapaata, Anne Kapaata, Anne Kapaata, Anne Kapaata
pmc-12416660.description: BackgroundOverweight and obesity are major concerns among people living with HIV (PLWH), particularly those on integrase inhibitors, as they elevate the risk of cardiovascular diseases. pmc-12632174.title: Toward a ToxAtlas of Carbon-Based Nanomaterials: Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Reveals Initiating Cell Circuits in Pulmonary Inflammation
pmc-12632174.creator: Carola Voss, Lianyong Han, Meshal Ansari, Maximilian Strunz, Verena Haefner, Ilias Angelidis, Christoph H. Mayr, Trine Berthing, Qiaoxia Zhou, Eva M. Guenther, Osama Huzain, Otmar Schmid, Ulla Vogel, Janine Gote-Schniering, Svenja Gaedcke, Fabian J. Theis, Herbert B. Schiller, Tobias Stoeger
pmc-12632174.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Understanding how nanomaterial properties drive acute lung inflammation is critical for the development of safer materials, but for low solubility carbon-based nanomaterials (CBNs) the initiation of the inflammatory response is still poorly understood. Leveraging single-cell RNA sequencing of mouse lungs, 12 h after intratracheally instillation with different CBN spherical carbon nanoparticles (CNP), tangled double-walled (DWCNT), and rigid multiwalled carbon nanotubes (MWCNT) and lipopolysaccharide (LPS) as positive control, we identified 41 cell states and delineated material-specific molecular initiation events at single-cell resolution.

pmc-13379766.title: Impressive Skin and Systemic Response Despite Patient Underestimation and Delayed Diagnosis of Blastic Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cell Neoplasm
pmc-13379766.creator: Emanuele Pacini, Beatrice Esposito Vangone, Adele Santoni, Margherita Malchiodi, Corrado Zuanelli Brambilla, Anna Sicuranza, Giulia Beffa, Monica Bocchia, Kalyani Sen
pmc-13379766.description: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) is a rare and aggressive hematologic malignancy derived from precursors of plasmacytoid dendritic cells (pDCs), most frequently presenting with cutaneous involvement and often progressing to bone marrow (BM), lymph node, and central nervous system (CNS) infiltration. Owing to its heterogeneous and often indolent initial presentation, diagnosis is frequently delayed, potentially worsening prognosis.
